lines.zh: 八条腿压过海床，沙都陷了。
lines.en: Eight legs press the seabed and the sand sinks.
I sway with each step and the water parts.

lines.zh: 巨钳拖在沙上，划出深沟。
lines.en: My giant claws drag, carving deep furrows.
I do not retreat, and no one can push me.
Three hundred hit points, and I walk steadily.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡挡路，我就碾过去。
lines.en: An iron golem in my way gets trampled.
My shadow arrives before my feet do.
Stones on the floor shatter under me.

lines.zh: 我横着走，整个海沟都窄了。
lines.en: I walk sideways and the trench feels narrow.

lines.zh: 每一步都让你的屏幕发颤。
lines.en: Every step makes your screen tremble.
I rest a giant claw on the reef.
The boss bar hangs above; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 没有像样的对手，我不起身。
lines.en: Without a worthy foe, I do not rise.

lines.zh: 小蟹座在脚边绕来绕去。
lines.en: The little crabs scurry around my feet.

lines.zh: 钳子一开一合，像在数拍。
lines.en: My claws open and shut like counting beats.
Seawater slides off my shell.
Arrows bounce off this armor of mine.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，海沟回音很长。
lines.en: I call once and the trench echoes long.

lines.zh: 生螃蟹的味道，我闻惯了。
lines.en: The smell of raw crab is familiar to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起钳子，看看有没有缺口。
lines.en: I lift a claw to check for chips.

lines.zh: 不详钓钩把我从深处拉上来。
lines.en: The Ominous Hook dragged me up from the deep.
I do not sleep; the seabed has no night.
Three hundred hit points give me time to think.

lines.zh: 我的钳子比你的船还大。
lines.en: My claw is bigger than your boat.

lines.zh: 我把钳子泡在凉水里，舒服。
lines.en: I soak my claws in the cold water.

lines.zh: 水里的蟹群打架，我不去管。
lines.en: Crabs quarrel below; I let them.
You stand at the edge of my trench.
I look down; you barely reach my claw tip.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我眼里是薄纸。
lines.en: Your armor looks like thin paper to me.

lines.zh: 你身上有钓鱼线的味道。
lines.en: You smell of fishing line.
I recognize that hook.

lines.zh: 你把我拉上来，就得付账。
lines.en: You pulled me up; now you pay.

lines.zh: 我看着你，血条先亮起来。
lines.en: I look at you and the boss bar lights up.
Do not hide behind the iron golem.
Retreat to shore and I can still follow.

lines.zh: 我眼里的光比钩子还亮。
lines.en: The glow in my eyes outshines the hook.

lines.zh: 你把武器握出汗了，很好。
lines.en: You have sweated onto your weapon; good.

lines.zh: 这里的水，从我上来那刻就归我。
lines.en: These waters became mine the moment I rose.

lines.zh: 你的武器只在我壳上留白印。
lines.en: Your weapon leaves only a white mark.
Three hundred hit points; grind them down.
Now that one had real weight.
A hairline crack opened in my shell.
I do not give ground; you do.
Pain? The deep's pressure hurts more.
You knocked the mud off me.
Harder, do not stop.
My claw twitched once.
I will return this wound to you.
Food? I feed on the whole sea.

lines.zh: 你把鱼丢下来，我踩碎了。
lines.en: You toss a fish down; I crush it.
I do not bow my head for a mouthful.

lines.zh: 生螃蟹我天天吃，不稀罕。
lines.en: I eat raw crab daily; it means nothing.

lines.zh: 想收买我？用整艘船试试。
lines.en: Bribe me? Try an entire ship.

lines.zh: 我的钳子不是讨食的碗。
lines.en: My claws are not a begging bowl.
Put it down, then get lost.

lines.zh: 这点分量，塞我的壳缝都不够。
lines.en: This much will not fill a seam in my shell.
I am not hungry; I only want a fight.
Put it away; do not insult me.

lines.zh: 你撞我腿骨，骨头都没响。
lines.en: You hit my leg bone and it did not ring.

lines.zh: 我连壳都没晃，你先退了。
lines.en: My shell did not sway; you backed off first.

lines.zh: 我的壳上没有退让的缝。
lines.en: There is no gap for yielding in my shell.
My claw's back knocks you away.
Step on my foot and you will regret it.

lines.zh: 整片沙地都在我脚下震。
lines.en: The whole sandbank shakes under me.
Pushing me? Try harder.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，水墙就压过来。
lines.en: I turn my flank and a wall of water shoves you.
You are the one who goes around, not I.
That collision should have cracked your shield.

lines.zh: 我这样的东西，没有伴侣。
lines.en: A thing like me has no mate.
The little crabs are my soldiers.
I do not breed; I only summon.
There is no second me in this trench.
Looking for a partner? Go haul a hook.
My claws exist only for smashing.
Loneliness is the price a boss pays.
Companions? That swarm at my feet does not count.

lines.zh: 我活得够久，不需要谁陪。
lines.en: I have lived long enough to need no one.
Come fight me and that counts as company.
I collect nothing; I break everything.

lines.zh: 你的剑掉了，我踩进沙里。
lines.en: Your sword drops; I trample it into the sand.

lines.zh: 巨钳夹不住细小的玩意。
lines.en: These giant claws cannot hold small things.

lines.zh: 掉落物在我脚下碎成渣。
lines.en: Loot shatters to dust beneath me.
Raw crab? That is for you lot.
What I want is the whole trench.
It sank; I cannot be bothered.
You need not hide your spoils.
I shove that plank of a boat aside.
Picking things up is for my underlings.

lines.zh: 你进了我的水，我看见你了。
lines.en: You entered my water; I see you.
The boss bar is lit; running is useless.
I have smashed three iron golems.
Target set; the trench is sealed.
I raise my claws and the water goes still.
That bit of iron in your hand is nothing.
I turn sideways and block the exit.

lines.zh: 距离三十步，我一步就到。
lines.en: Thirty steps away, and I need one.
Remember, you swung first.

lines.zh: 我的钳子已经举到头顶。
lines.en: My claws are already above my head.
I summon the small crabs to surround you first.

lines.zh: 你退到珊瑚后面，我更高兴。
lines.en: Retreat behind the coral; that pleases me.
The trench has waited long for this fight.

lines.zh: 锁定你了，别再假装路过。
lines.en: You are locked in; stop pretending to pass by.

lines.zh: 你在岸上跺脚，水纹传到我这儿。
lines.en: You stomp ashore; the ripples reach me.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼竿，也算武器吗？
lines.en: Is that fishing rod meant as a weapon?

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从礁石后面。
lines.en: I see you from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 这一片海归我，你来晚了。
lines.en: This sea is mine; you came late.
I wait for your shield to drop.
My giant claws rise slowly, gathering force.
You go left, and my claw follows.
Your steps have scuffed the sand.

lines.zh: 我听着你胸腔里的鼓点。
lines.en: I listen to the drumbeat inside your chest.
The small crabs wait at your feet.
This claw will split the ground.
Changed weapons? As you like.
I left an opening on purpose.
You took the bait; look up.

lines.zh: 满值击退抗性，推不动我。
lines.en: Full knockback resistance; you cannot move me.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，你就没路了。
lines.en: Half a step forward and you have no path.
Your reinforcements are still on shore.
I will wait for you to catch this breath.

lines.zh: 你的戟太短，够不到我的壳。
lines.en: Your trident is too short for this shell.

lines.zh: 我抬起左边这只，你就往右躲。
lines.en: I lift the left claw; you dodge right.

lines.zh: 你把弓箭举起来了，先射吧。
lines.en: Bow raised? Shoot first, then.

lines.zh: 我听见你脚下的沙在滑。
lines.en: I hear the sand sliding under you.

lines.zh: 小蟹座堵住你身后的水道。
lines.en: Little crabs block the channel behind you.
I will wait until you finish that potion.
The giant claw falls and the sand splits.
Eight points of damage in a single blow.

lines.zh: 我把铁傀儡砸进了岩壁。
lines.en: I smashed the iron golem into the cliff.
My claws close and your shield breaks.

lines.zh: 这一击带着整片海的水。
lines.en: This swing carries the whole sea behind it.
You are driven to your knees in the sand.
I do not stop until you stop moving.
My claw tip rakes your chestplate.
The splash rises above my head.
The small crabs pile on after me.
Still standing? Then another.

lines.zh: 我的钳子从不落空两次。
lines.en: My claws never miss twice.

lines.zh: 这一下是给钩子的回礼。
lines.en: This one is my thanks for the hook.

lines.zh: 你听见壳碰铁的声音了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear shell strike iron?

lines.zh: 不详钓钩把我从深处拽上来。
lines.en: The Ominous Hook drags me up from the deep.

lines.zh: 血条一亮，海沟都知道我来了。
lines.en: The boss bar lights and the trench knows I have come.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋也能叫我出来，真随便。
lines.en: A spawn egg can call me too; how casual.

lines.zh: 我的钳子先破水，然后是我。
lines.en: My claws break the surface first, then the rest of me.
Three hundred years? No, three hundred hit points.

lines.zh: 海底的泥还挂在我壳上。
lines.en: Seabed mud still clings to my shell.
I land and the whole shoal shakes.

lines.zh: 小蟹座已经在脚边聚齐。
lines.en: The small crabs are already gathered at my feet.
Who dares stand before me?

lines.zh: 我张开钳子，试了试力道。
lines.en: I open my claws and test their strength.

lines.zh: 这场架，从钩子落下就开始了。
lines.en: This fight began when the hook fell.
I have never spawned naturally.

lines.zh: 你把我放出来，就别后悔。
lines.en: You released me; do not regret it.

lines.zh: 海沟的水位都涨了一寸。
lines.en: The trench's water rose an inch.

lines.zh: 钩子一沉，我就顺着线往上。
lines.en: The hook sinks; I climb the line.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a trench crack.

lines.zh: 水先浑了一片，然后是我。
lines.en: The water muddies first, then I rise.

lines.zh: 八条腿踩稳，我才抬起头。
lines.en: Eight legs steady, then I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你听见水响的时候，已经迟了。
lines.en: Hear the splash, and you are late.

lines.zh: 浅滩太窄，我只好拆点礁石。
lines.en: The shallows are narrow; I break some reef.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧不久，但够烫。
lines.en: Fire does not last underwater, but it stings.

lines.zh: 我从海沟摔下来也没散。
lines.en: Even falling from the trench did not break me.

lines.zh: 我在水下三百年，呛不了。
lines.en: Three hundred years underwater; I cannot drown.
The blast strips the mud from half my body.

lines.zh: 箭杆插在壳缝里，像根木刺。
lines.en: An arrow shaft sticks in my seam like a splinter.

lines.zh: 紫光钻进壳缝，麻了一下。
lines.en: Violet light seeps into my seams and numbs me.
When I starve, the trench empties.

lines.zh: 雷打在我壳上，亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell and flashes bright.

lines.zh: 虚空比海沟更深，我不去。
lines.en: The void is deeper than my trench; I will not go.
